title: SDK OCR run route has no route-level authentication or authorization dependency
reasoning: The SDK router is created without visible dependencies, and POST /api/sdk/ocr/run accepts network input and immediately resolves an image source and runs OCR using only ContainerDep. For an SDK-facing route that crosses network, user-input, serialization, and auth boundaries, this leaves the handler with no local proof that the caller is authenticated or authorized to submit the referenced image for OCR. Confidence is medium because a parent router or application-level dependency could still protect this route outside the provided excerpt, but the owned route itself does not enforce or document that invariant.
recommendation: Add an explicit SDK auth/session dependency to this router or route, or document and test the parent-level protection in a way that fails if the route is mounted without it.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No linked tests were provided for this feature, and the excerpt contains no route-level assertion or dependency that would make the auth requirement testable here.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a FastAPI route test for POST /api/sdk/ocr/run that verifies unauthenticated requests are rejected and authenticated SDK requests can reach the OCR service with mocked OCR execution.
minimumFixScope: backend/src/api/routes/sdk/router.py plus focused backend route tests for the SDK OCR route authentication contract.
